source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Stimulating beta receptors as its primary mechanism of lowering blood pressure","B":"Blocking both alpha and beta receptors, providing blood pressure reduction without significant reflex tachycardia","C":"Blocking alpha receptors on their own, without any accompanying effect on beta receptors","D":"Causing direct vasodilation through a mechanism that does not involve any adrenergic receptor activity"}}
source_row.rationale: Labetalol blocks both alpha and beta receptors, providing effective blood pressure reduction while minimizing reflex tachycardia, making it a commonly used agent for hypertensive emergencies including in pregnancy.
source_row.source_name: ACOG — Hypertensive Emergency Management in Pregnancy
